D001.statement: The proposed Chapter 13.63 expressly does not regulate the amount of rent a landlord may charge. This is a limitation of this chapter, not a finding that Berkeley has no rent-increase limits.

evidence.quote:
Nor does this 
Chapter regulate the amount of rent that a landlord may charge. This Chapter solely 
regulates the use and sale of the coordinated pricing algorithms, to prevent the harms 
described above.
BE IT ORDAINED by the Council of the City of Berkeley as follows:

D009.statement: The guide marks new-construction units built and receiving a certificate of occupancy after June 1980, single-family homes with tenancies beginning on or after January 1, 1996, most condominiums, Section 202 and Section 811 units, and the specified HUD-mortgage-linked subsidized units as not covered by this ordinance's rent control. Overlapping unit categories are not resolved. This is not a finding that other rent-increase rules are absent.
